All J orders occurring in choices are nu+1 and covered by the displayed series.

For0<z<=2, after factoring the leading positive monomial, the alternating series is positive: for nu>=1 the first pair is positive; for nu=0 at z2 the next pair1/4−1/36 is strictly positive. Thus every positive root alpha>2.

correctTaskRoute: Bessel ODE boundary identity and derivative recurrence give J_(nu+1)(alpha)^2/2. Positive zeros exceed2 by the alternating defining series; the adjacent-order value is nonzero by ODE uniqueness.
